news.headline: UK inflation holds steady at 2.8% in May
news.summary: The Bank of England is due to update its monetary policy on Thursday.
news.takeaway: The Bank of England is due to update its monetary policy on Thursday; use it as global rate-sensitivity evidence; India needs bond-market confirmation before banks inherit the signal.
news.whyItMatters: Rate-sensitive sectors need yield stability; without that, gap-up moves in high-duration names deserve skepticism.
news.indiaImpact: Bank Nifty and rate-sensitive sectors care only if global yields follow through and local breadth weakens.
news.watchFor: Watch 2.8% and Indian bank breadth; no rate trade if yields fade.

news.headline: Three Iranian tankers exit U.S. blockade for first time in months as shipowners eye Hormuz in 'wary disbelief'
news.summary: At least three Iranian tankers carrying nearly five million barrels of crude oil have exited the U.S. Navy blockade.
news.takeaway: At least three Iranian tankers carrying nearly five million barrels of crude oil have exited the US Navy; treat it as supply-discipline evidence; India impact travels through sustained Brent direction, not the meeting headline alone.
news.whyItMatters: India imports most of its crude, so the same story can pressure inflation expectations while helping upstream energy.
news.indiaImpact: OMCs, aviation and tyres stay under pressure only if the OPEC+ signal keeps Brent bid; upstream energy is the offset.
news.watchFor: Watch Brent around the Asia handoff; OMC risk stays live only if supply headlines keep prices firm.
